prompt: Down a 1930s suburban street of semi-detached houses in the rain: every single house has steel shutters over its windows and door, and every front garden is piled with the family's furniture, mattresses, a sofa, boxes and lamps under bin bags, a few adults standing by their piles, a line of grey vans at the kerb. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
